strategy_principles: Use the six-team profile only for bounded research and advisory comparison; it is not a live LeagueConfig.
Draft from forecast records and select daily starters from forecast values plus the known synthetic schedule.
Score the forecast-selected starter IDs with a separate realized-stat world after selection so realized values do not leak into draft decisions.
Compare custom per-game, availability, market, lineup-aware, and fixed big-preference strategies on paired pools and seats.
Select a strategy on development seeds only and audit the fixed choice on independent held-out pool seeds.
evidence_limitations: All pools, schedules, opponent profiles, availability, bonus rates, and realized shocks are generated assumptions rather than NBA or ESPN observations.
Native eligibility uses PG/SG/SF/PF/C records with G/F eligibility matching for generic slots; it is a research model, not a live ESPN rules probe.
IR is null and unverified in this profile; no IR behavior is modeled.
The lineup-aware score is a transparent slot-coverage heuristic and is not production marginal-lineup-v1.
The profile assumes daily lineups, no keeper rules, and snake draft order for this bounded study.
The small independent seed sets support reproducible sensitivity checks, not calibrated win probabilities or league forecasts.
